theme.$description: Hexcoded — Light theme. Locked to Brand Book v1.0 Final (2026-05-22). Tech Green #22C55E is THE brand colour; Outfit display + Inter body + JetBrains Mono code. Source: design-system-final/index.html (Section 05 · Tokens).

bg-soft.$description: Subtle inset / grouped sections — Apple-soft grey

accent.$description: Tech Green — THE Hexcoded brand colour (Tailwind green-500 · RGB 34 197 94 · PANTONE 354 C). Locked L02.

accent-deep.$description: Tech Green deep — interactive pressed / hover-down

accent-light.$description: Tech Green light — hover background / soft accent surfaces

accent-whisper.$description: Tech Green whisper — subtlest accent tint (banner backgrounds)

status.$description: Hexcoded status scale — locked L19. Success === accent (Tech Green); warning amber; danger red; info sky.

success.$description: Success / approved — same as brand accent (intentional)

font.$description: Hexcoded typography — locked L05. Outfit display + Inter body + JetBrains Mono code. Multi-language coverage for US · EU · India.

display.$description: Display / wordmark / headers — Outfit at weight 900 in the wordmark
Display weight — Outfit Black for wordmark (locked L05/L06)

motion.$description: Hexcoded motion scale — locked L04. 3s ease-in-out is the Phantom breath cycle on the wordmark (in brand-hexcoded). UI durations below are for components.

ease.$description: Default easing — gentle out-back curve for surfaces

max-width.$description: Maximum content width on landing / dashboard surfaces
